items.title: Which fields contain the selected non-standard Burmese spellings?
assumptions: The check is limited to the 58 IDs and the exact spelling-pattern group identified in the earlier audit.
Internal portal snapshots, provenance JSON, URLs, and image fields are excluded.

source.label: Wildlife animal database
caveats: The result identifies fields containing the selected patterns; it does not edit or automatically correct any value.

evidenceFlow.title: Pattern and field check
evidenceFlow.detail: Each requested animal record was scanned for the selected ဥ်/ဉ်, ဦး/ဦး, and အဆောက်အဦး/အဆောက်အဦ spelling patterns, with matching field names retained.

sourceRoles.label: wildlife.db
sourceRoles.role: Current animal names and published Burmese-facing field values used for the read-only scan.

methods.code: Open wildlife.db with SQLite mode=ro; for each requested ID, scan published Burmese-facing fields for the selected spelling patterns and retain matching field names.
